Chapter 312: Chapter 13 - Fame Spreads Far And Wide (Request For Subscription)

Chapter 312: Chapter 13 – Fame Spreads Far and Wide (Request for Subscription)

Exhale!

Inhale!

Deep within the Great Hall of the Thirteen Peaks.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, experiencing a significant transformation of both body and soul after entering the Seventh Rank.

Now, Lin Yuan… merely his foundational destructive power had surged dozens of times, and if the amplification from his understanding of the rules and the support of the Taiji Inner World in his body were added…

Probably only Seventh-Rank Kings as Evolvers could match Lin Yuan.

...

“Taiji Inner World…”

Lin Yuan’s mind plunged into the Dantian Qi Sea.

A small world had already been formed there.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan’s mind descended into the small world.

This was a small world swirling in black and white, where everything looked desolate at a glance.

Yet, Lin Yuan did not find it strange. The small world had just been created; everything was yet to be developed.

“Normally, the inner worlds of Eighth-Rank Evolvers are often about a hundred miles in radius.”

“But this small world of mine is merely ten miles in radius?”

Lin Yuan looked around, thinking to himself.

As the creator of this small world, Lin Yuan was like a god of creation, knowing everything inside the small world with just a thought.

“True.”

“The inner worlds created by Eighth-Rank Evolvers have a strong physical body as their foundation, hence they can bear a world of a hundred miles.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Evolver who can cultivate to the Eighth Rank at least follow the Eighth-Rank Evolutionary Path.

Such evolutionary paths are almost as strong as the current Martial Path Evolutionary Path, especially since they only try to create an inner world after reaching the peak of Seventh Rank.

A Seventh-Rank Peak body and soul are naturally a bit stronger than Lin Yuan’s Sixth-Rank Peak body and soul.

The initial size of the inner worlds they create naturally has an advantage.

Of course.

The initial size of the inner world is irrelevant.

Because the inner world has the attribute of growth, it can slowly expand.

Currently, Lin Yuan’s inner world is only ten miles in size, but as Lin Yuan’s realm ascends and his strength increases, the inner world will grow to hundreds or even thousands of miles.

“The power of the world…”

Lin Yuan raised his right hand and observed it carefully.

After the Taiji Inner World formed, it began to emit the power of the world, slowly transforming Lin Yuan’s body and soul.

The power of the world, almost omnipotent, could enhance Lin Yuan’s attacks, guard his body and soul, and also slowly improve various aspects.

“Although I’ve just entered the Seventh Rank, with the boost from the power of the world, my actual combat power may have already reached the peak of Seventh Rank…”

Lin Yuan silently thought.

The power of the world, that is an exclusive force of Eighth-Rank Evolvers.

The inner world Lin Yuan had just opened, even if it was weaker than the inner worlds of Eighth-Rank Evolvers, still gave birth to the power of the world. Among the Seventh-Rank Evolvers, it was almost like cheating.

Most importantly.

Most of those at the peak of the Seventh Rank, their upper limits were set in stone, and the only way to advance was to attempt to break through to the Eighth Rank.

But Lin Yuan… his inner world had just been opened, possessing almost unlimited potential for growth, which might enable him someday to compete with Eighth-Rank Evolvers while still at the peak of the Seventh Rank.

“Inner world…”

Lin Yuan once again carefully felt the inner world inside his Dantian Qi Sea.

Although it was only ten miles in radius, it was a complete world, its aura circulating perfectly. As long as Lin Yuan wished, outsiders couldn’t detect the existence of the inner world.

“My Yin God…”

Lin Yuan slightly raised his head, looking in the direction of Battlefield C24763.

With the breakthrough of his real body, even the Taiyin Primordial Spirit began to transform, its Primordial Spirit power becoming more and more pure, instantly reaching the Seventh Rank.

“It’s a pity… the Primordial Spirit doesn’t have a physical body and cannot give birth to an inner world…”

Lin Yuan shook his head lightly.

“However, if the Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit are combined, evolve Taiji, and are combined with an understanding of Space Rules, perhaps it could give birth to a phantom spiritual world?”

Lin Yuan speculated in his mind.

A single Taiyin and Taiyang, even with the integration of space rules, couldn’t form a complete world, but combined, it’s different.

“Have the teachers arrived?”

Lin Yuan glanced outside, immediately got up, and walked out of the hall.

“Teacher.”

“Fellow apprentice brothers.”

Lin Yuan came out and smiled.

He didn’t intend to conceal his breakthrough to the Seventh Rank, and it couldn’t be concealed, either.

In human civilization, as long as Lin Yuan was part of the Human Race, the more terrifying his talent, the greater the resource tilt he would receive.

“Good disciple,” Chikun Star Lord smiled and looked at Lin Yuan, “In less than two years, you’ve stepped into the Seventh Rank; that is much stronger than your teacher back then…”

Chikun Star Lord himself took thousands of years to step into the Seventh Rank.

However, Chikun Star Lord’s true form was the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun,

such special beings generally require a long time to break through.

And here, “a long time” is relative to the Human Race.

The lifespans of special beings are generally calculated in millions of years, and so-called thousands of years are just a few naps.

Many special beings sleep for a few hundred or thousand years at a time, equivalent to half a lifetime for an ordinary Human Race Evolver.

“Little junior brother, slow down your cultivation; any faster and you’ll surpass me…” Third Senior Brother jokingly said from the side.

In the Red Kun Lineage, the Great Peak Master is a Seventh-Rank Peak King, while the Second and Third Peak Masters are Seventh-Rank Marquis Level.

Lin Yuan had just entered the Seventh Rank and, in the eyes of his Third Senior Brother, was at the Marquis Level within the Seventh Rank.

So, the Third Senior Brother believed Lin Yuan hadn’t surpassed him yet.

However, in terms of pure combat power, perhaps only Chikun Star Lord could suppress Lin Yuan; otherwise, even the eldest senior brother might not be his match.
